Findings:  No significant joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intrasubstance degeneration of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is again noted. Complex tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, this is new on comparison to previous imaging.  Normal appearance of the distal biceps femoris tendon, distal iliotibial band, pes anserine tendons and popliteus tendon.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Focal osteochondral injury in the posterior non weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle is again appreciated with subarticular cystic change, and reduced surrounding bone marrow edema. Otherwise well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline cartilage.  
Conclusion: Complex tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Ancillary findings described above.

Technique: MRI of the knee. ACL normal. MCL normal. Medial meniscus mucoid degeneration. Lateral meniscus normal. Incipient chondromalacia of all three compartments. No Baker's cyst. No effusion. Coclusion: Medial meniscus mucoid degeneration.  Incipient chondromalacia of all three compartments.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 7 months of right knee pain after fall
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Residual osseous contusion about the anterior tibial plateau and posteromedial tibial plateau. Edema and cortical deformity at the posterior tibial metaphysis likely related to prior trauma. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Chondral fissuring in the patella. Maintenance of trochlear cartilage. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Subcutaneous edema anterior to the patellar tendon.

IMPRESSION:

1. Residual osseous contusion about the anterior tibial plateau and the posteromedial tibial plateau.

2. Mild patellar chondrosis.

In the medial compartment, there is buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the intercondylar notch. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
  
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There is focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1* intact5 cm). 
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1* intact5 cm), left knee. 
  Buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn.

  Some amount of left knee effusion.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 8 months, sharp, intermittent, 7/10 pain with activities; not improving with physical therapy
Comparison: No relevant prior MRI studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right mild knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a horizontal tear extending from the posterior horn to the anterior horn, with a 4 mm posterior horn perimeniscal cyst. No meniscal extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Diffuse thinning with focal high-grade cartilage loss spanning the weightbearing surface and the lateral tibial plateau. 

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellar cartilage: Diffuse heterogeneous signal intensity with focal high-grade fissuring at the lateral facet.
Trochlear cartilage: Heterogeneous signal intensity with foci of high-grade fissuring at the medial and lateral trochlear cartilage.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild partial thickness tear at the distal quadriceps tendon insertion site.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Patella alta with lateral patellar tilt. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Mild prepatellar soft tissue edema. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Horizontal tear of the lateral meniscus small perimeniscal cyst. No meniscal extrusion.
2.	High-grade chondrosis involving the lateral and patellofemoral compartments. 
3.	Small knee joint effusion.

Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon ve serbest kenarda eşlik eden horizontal yırtık izlendi. Lateral menisküs anterior ve posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlendi. Lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Posterior çapraz bağ T2 sinyalinde diffüz artıi izlenmekte olup grade II sprain izlendi.Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlendi ( grade I sprain ).Femur lateral kondil posterior süperior kesim komşuluğunda 17x13 mm boyutlu ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti izlendi. Popliteal fossada 6,5 x1,5 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlendi. Femur interkondiler çentik ve tibia interkondiler eminenciada çapraz bağlar yapışma düzeyinde subkortikal dejeneratif milimetrik kistler izlendi. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan üç kompartmanda santral -marjinal osteofit formasyonları izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda incelme ve destrüksiyon izlenmektedir. Tibia medial platoda subkondral alanda ödem izlendi.
